exposure: Pregnancy complications (antepartum hemorrhage, preeclampsia/eclampsia, premature rupture of membranes)
cohort: Singleton preterm (26-36+6 weeks gestation) and term births
finding: While gestational age at birth and mode of delivery impacted survival, maternal factors like parity, marital status, pregnancy complications, and antenatal care did not affect the survival of singleton preterm babies.
mod_finding: Survival of preterm babies was dependent on mode of delivery.
